risk_note: RV2 ledger (B2-02w; BR-FUND-22; D10-1401). The workbench card recon_diff_open gets a per-app read-only count, countReconDiffOpen(db, appId), exported from ledger/index.ts. It reuses the console list's own judgement: the filter builder of listAdminReconDiffs is extracted as reconDiffListFilter(appId, query) and the count calls countAdminReconDiffs with reconDiffListFilter(appId, { status: 'open' }), so the card equals the total of GET /admin/v1/recon-diffs?status=open (R1-R3 only, as the list; processing not counted, D10-1401, confirmed D10-1464 ②). No write, no audit, no amount; list behaviour unchanged. No migration, no contract.
